name: The Sweetest Thing
source:
Henri Dupont, famous pastry chef and the man you've admired for years, opens a bakery right across from yours! Now you two are bitter rivals, but the sexual tension is undeniable. Things are about to get even hotter in the kitchen when you and Henri enter the same baking competition! Can you create a sweet masterpiece together, or will it burn into ash?

[From in-app]
translation:
著名糕点师亨利·杜邦 (Henri Dupont) 是你多年来仰慕的人，他在你的对面开了一家面包店！现在你们两个是死对头，但性方面的紧张是不可否认的。当你和亨利参加同一个烘焙比赛时，厨房里的事情将会变得更加激烈！你们能否共同创作出甜蜜的杰作，还是会化为灰烬？

[来自应用程序内]
